areas.summary:
Inventory of the landing page (web/src/pages/site/Landing.tsx, sections/*.tsx, site.tsx, SiteIcon.tsx). Read only, nothing was edited.

What the admin can already edit: only the 14 PublicSettings fields come from the API. The ones that show on the landing are centre_name, phone, address, instagram, open, close and allow_pay_on_arrival (Settings form in web/src/team/Settings.tsx, stored as one JSON row in the D1 `settings` table, defaults in api/src/settings.ts DEFAULT_SETTINGS). Admins can also edit rooms (name, type, capacity, contents, prices, active, description) under team/Rooms.tsx. Everything else on the landing is a literal in TSX: all headings, leads, lists, FAQ, CTA, images and section layout. There is no content table, no image upload and no room or group photo field.

Main problems the CMS should fix:
(1) Some facts are written into the text, so they don't follow the settings or room data. These are: meeting room for 10 people (Hero badge, Features, GROUP_META blurb and fallbackCap, FAQ), open space for 8, private rooms 2–4 and the fallback of 4 private rooms (Facts, SpacesPreview), the street and building name (Facts item 2, Hero lead), and the brand name inside strings (page title, Features kicker, Gallery lead, Facts aria).
(2) The WhatsApp link (wa.me/963985258963) and phoneIntl are hard-coded and do not follow settings.phone.
(3) Pay on arrival is inconsistent. The site assumes TRUE until settings load (site.tsx l.92), but the API default is false. The CtaBand text always mentions paying on arrival, whatever the setting. Hero, HowItWorks and FAQ each keep two text variants.
(4) The default address is different in two places: 'درعا – …' in CENTRE vs 'درعا، …' in the API.
(5) Hours are one open/close pair for every day. There are no per-weekday hours, days off or temporary closures, and the words "كل يوم" / "يومياً" are hard-coded in 5 strings.
(6) The settings API supports timezone, but the admin form does not show it.
(7) Room sort order has no UI.
(8) Section order, visibility and tint are hard-coded in Landing.tsx.
(9) IMG.think and CENTRE.latin are defined but never used.

Placeholders in the values below, like {hours}, {phone}, {open}, {close}, {address}, {privateCount}, {hoursPerDay} and {title}, stand for live data the code inserts. A CMS should keep them as tokens. Text in [label](/path) form is an inline router Link.

areas.summary:
Inventory for: Spaces/About/Contact pages, site header/footer/bottom nav/centre.ts, the shared helpers they pull from site.tsx and sections/Gallery.tsx, index.html, privacy.html, the PWA manifest and the Android TWA. Nothing was edited.

What is already editable today, all in team/Settings.tsx:
- Settings › المركز: centre_name, phone, address, instagram, open/close hours, slot, min and max duration, hold minutes.
- Settings › الدفع: Sham Cash fields and allow_pay_on_arrival.
- Rooms admin: room name, type, capacity, description, contents and prices.
- timezone can be changed through the API (PATCH /v1/admin/settings) but has no field in the admin screen.

Everything else on these pages is hard-coded. That covers all headings, body text, lists, nav menus, images, SEO/OG/JSON-LD, the privacy page and the manifest.

Problems the CMS should fix:
1. The visible brand ignores settings.centre_name. The only place that reads it is web/src/lib/ics.ts (the calendar event title). The wordmark 'Focus Point', the subtitle 'فوكس بوينت · درعا', the About H1, the page titles and index.html all have the name written in.
2. Centre facts are defined twice: CENTRE in components/site/centre.ts and again in pages/site/site.tsx. The two copies have different helpers: telHref adds +963 in one and not the other, and mapsUrl uses two different Google Maps URL formats. The API default address (api/src/settings.ts L29) also uses a comma where the web fallback uses '–'.
3. Some WhatsApp links ignore the phone setting. These use the fixed CENTRE.whatsapp / phoneIntl (+963985258963, wa.me/963985258963): the Contact page WhatsApp card, the WhatsApp button in Contact's how-to-find-us card, the CtaBand 'اسألنا عالواتساب' button and Landing's Visit section. The header menu and footer build the link from settings.phone. So if the admin changes the phone, these links stay on the old number. A separate whatsapp setting is needed.
4. Text that copies live data and can go out of date:
   - Room capacities are written into the text in Spaces lead, GROUP_META blurbs and fallbackCap, and About audience: 2–4, 10, 8. The rooms themselves are editable.
   - Street and building in the Contact route steps are written in, not taken from the address setting.
   - Hours are written into the index.html description ('يومياً من 9 الصبح لـ 11 بالليل') and into the JSON-LD.
   - Phone, address and Instagram are written into the JSON-LD and the privacy page.
5. The default CtaBand text always promises 'أو عند وصولك' (pay on arrival), but allow_pay_on_arrival defaults to false in the API. Also, useSiteData().payOnArrival reads true until settings load.
6. Room photos are per group, not per room: meeting group → room-a, open group → room-b-wide, private group → none. Room has no image field and there is no upload. The Gallery is a fixed set of 4 photos in fixed grid slots.
7. Opening hours are one daily window. 'Every day' is written into the copy and the JSON-LD has all 7 days. There is no per-weekday schedule, closed days or holidays.
8. index.html (title, description, OG, JSON-LD) is a static file that the Worker serves through ASSETS (run_worker_first=true). Crawlers and WhatsApp link previews don't run JS, so live values need an HTMLRewriter step in api/src/index.ts serveApp().
9. The PWA manifest is generated at build time, so it would need to be served dynamically to be editable.
10. The Android app name 'فوكس بوينت', status-bar colour #FFFFFF and launcher icons are baked into the APK. Changing them needs a rebuild and store update; the CMS cannot change them.
11. privacy.html states retention periods: 24 months, 12 months, 90 days, and 7 working days to handle a deletion request. api/src/cron.ts has no job that purges data. The 6-character booking code is real (api/src/bookings.ts L150).

The navigation lists (header, mobile menu, footer, bottom nav) are fixed and separate from each other. Instagram is the only social account supported. Sections can't be hidden or reordered, and per-page meta is limited to client-side document.title.

Overlap with other areas: GROUP_META, IMG, CtaBand and the Gallery defaults also feed Landing. ROOM_TYPE and the amenity labels live in web/src/lib/booking.ts.

areas.summary:
Inventory of the customer booking app (/book, /book/:roomId, /b/:id, /mine, /inbox, their components, lib/booking.ts, format.ts, api.ts, ics.ts, sw.ts) and of the server-side customer/team message texts (api/src/notify.ts, cron.ts, bookings.ts, service.ts, routes/public.ts, payments.ts, tz.ts). Read only, nothing was edited.

WHAT THE ADMIN CAN ALREADY EDIT. The settings row (api/src/settings.ts DEFAULT_SETTINGS L26-44, edited in /team/settings):
- Tab «المركز»: centre_name, phone, address, instagram, open, close, slot_minutes (30 or 60 only), min_minutes, max_minutes, hold_minutes.
- Tab «الدفع»: shamcash_number, shamcash_name, shamcash_qr, payment_instructions, allow_pay_on_arrival.
- /team/plan: the floor plan's walls and labels.
- /team/rooms: per room name, type, capacity, contents, price_hour, price_day, color, description, active, sort.
- /team/customers: blocked phones.
- «إعلان» tab: free-form announcements.
- timezone is accepted by PATCH /v1/admin/settings, but no settings page shows it.

WHAT IS HARD-CODED.
- Every customer-facing heading, explanation, status text and empty state in the booking flow.
- The 3 Sham Cash payment steps.
- All 7 automatic notification titles and bodies (notify.ts texts). «نراك في فوكس بوينت!» does not use centre_name.
- Room-type labels, icons and colours.
- Amenity labels, and the fixed set of 8 amenities.
- Status badge labels.
- Weekday and month names, the currency «ل.س», and duration and people wording.
- Error messages.
- Business constants:
  - booking window of 14 days
  - default duration 120 min
  - a 5-min grace on today's slots
  - curated duration list
  - full-day price from 8 h
  - hold grace 10 min
  - stale-verification close 30 min after the end
  - reminder 55–65 min before
  - cron every 5 min
  - max 3 open holds per phone
  - name 2–40 chars, note ≤300, payment ref 4–40
  - booking code 6 chars
  - customer may cancel only before confirmation
  - Syrian 09XXXXXXXX phones only
  - same opening hours every day (no closed days or holidays)
  - /mine shows 90 days of history
  - inbox shows 100 items
  - install-hint snooze 14 days
  - .ics alarm 60 min before
  - push TTL 24 h

BUGS AND MISMATCHES FOUND ON THE WAY.
- The server throws 'too_many_pending' (service.ts:104) but web/src/api.ts maps 'too_many_open'. The customer sees the generic 429 text.
- 'too_many_people' is not mapped either, so the customer gets 'البيانات المدخلة غير صحيحة'.
- The name input allows 60 characters (Book.tsx:92) but the server accepts at most 40 (service.ts:86).
- A stale awaiting_verification booking that cron expires sends booking_expired, which says «لم يصلنا رقم عملية الدفع» even though the customer did submit a reference (cron.ts:32).
- The NotifyPrompt default text starts with «خبّرك», which looks like a typo for «نخبّرك».
- BookingPage hard-codes fallbacks for the address and phone that duplicate the settings defaults.
- room.color is editable in admin but not used on the customer booking screens, which colour rooms by type (ui/roomTone.ts).
- When a customer cancels, the team gets no notification.

Proposed keys use the prefixes book.*, booking.*, mine.*, inbox.*, pay.*, room.*, common.*, notify.*, rule.* and error.*. Templated values keep their {placeholders}.

areas.summary:
Read-only inventory of what the admin can already edit, plus every business rule. Paths are relative to /home/user/lovable.dev/focuspoint.

HOW SETTINGS ARE STORED: table `settings` (api/schema.sql:85-88) holds a single row (id=1, CHECK id=1) with one column `data TEXT`, a JSON StoredSettings object (Settings without vapid_public_key). On read, api/src/settings.ts:46-55 loadStoredSettings returns `{...DEFAULT_SETTINGS, ...stored, plan: stored.plan ?? DEFAULT_PLAN}`. So a new key added to DEFAULT_SETTINGS shows up with its default and needs no migration. saveSettings (settings.ts:132-137) writes the whole merged object back with INSERT…ON CONFLICT DO UPDATE. After the first save, the defaults in effect at that time are written into the row, so a later change to a code default does not reach a centre that has already saved. Validation is a per-field whitelist in validateSettingsPatch (settings.ts:88-130); unknown keys are dropped silently. Cross-field rules: open<close, min≤max, min and max are multiples of slot_minutes. There is no seed row (api/seed.sql only seeds rooms), and there is no migration for settings.

HOW SETTINGS ARE WRITTEN: PATCH /v1/admin/settings (admin.ts:24-29, admin only) exists, but the web never calls it. The team panel queues `settings_patch` ops through store.patchSettings (web/src/team/store.ts:280) → POST /v1/team/sync, where applyOp checks for an admin (api/src/routes/sync.ts:21, 47-52). These ops work offline and replay in order.

HOW SETTINGS ARE READ: public GET /v1/settings (public.ts:50) returns PublicSettings (shared/types.ts:118: centre_name, phone, address, instagram, timezone, open, close, slot_minutes, min/max/hold_minutes, allow_pay_on_arrival, plan, vapid_public_key). It does not return shamcash_* or payment_instructions. Customers get those only through GET /v1/bookings/:id → payment (PaymentInfo, public.ts:33-39), and only for Sham Cash bookings. The team (staff too) gets the full Settings in GET /v1/team/sync (sync.ts:79). GET /v1/admin/settings also exists but is unused. On the web, useCached('/v1/settings') (web/src/lib/data.ts:16) is network-first through cachedGet (web/src/offline.ts:74, IndexedDB 'focuspoint'/kv key `get:/v1/settings`), with an in-memory memo and a reload on focus or when the connection returns. The service worker (web/src/sw.ts:35) also caches /v1/settings, /v1/rooms and /v1/availability network-first in the 'fp-api-v1' cache. The server sends Cache-Control: no-store (api/src/http.ts:17). Consumers: App PushKeeper (vapid key, timezone), components/site/centre.ts useCentre (header/footer), pages/site/site.tsx useSiteData (marketing pages), Home, Book, BookingPage, NotifyPrompt. Fallbacks while loading or offline are the hard-coded CENTRE objects. There are two copies of them: web/src/pages/site/site.tsx:12-24 and web/src/components/site/centre.ts:6-19. A CMS content blob could follow the same path: a JSON row, a public GET with useCached, the SW cache, and admin writes through settings_patch-style ops.

MEDIA / BLOB STORAGE: none today. wrangler.toml binds only D1 (DB) and static ASSETS (web/dist); there is no R2 and no KV. The only image the admin can store is shamcash_qr, a base64 data URL inside the settings JSON. It is limited to ≤300 KB, PNG/JPEG/WebP (settings.ts:66-67), and the client shrinks it to 512 px first (team/Settings.tsx:131-152). Room rows have no image column. Every site photo is a static file in web/public/img, mapped in site.tsx:26-32 (IMG). Admin-uploadable images need either an R2 binding (new) or data URLs in D1. D1 caps a single value/row at about 2 MB, so a gallery should not live inside the settings row.

ALREADY EDITABLE BY ADMIN: the settings fields below (Settings › المركز / الدفع tabs, and /team/plan); rooms (/team/rooms sheet: name, type, capacity, contents, prices, colour, active, description; plan position via /team/plan); team accounts (Settings › الفريق); announcements (Settings › إعلان); customer blocking (/team/customers). Reports are read-only. Not editable in the UI: timezone (API only), room sort order (API only), room photos, amenity list, room types, payment-method list, every timing rule (grace, reminders, stale verification, cron), the booking horizon, the day-price threshold, the open-holds limit, all notification texts, the WhatsApp number, slogan/tagline, quick reject reasons.

BUGS / MISMATCHES SEEN: (1) The server throws 'too_many_pending' (service.ts:104) but the customer error map has 'too_many_open' (web/src/api.ts:67), so the customer sees the generic 429 text 'محاولات كثيرة، جرّب بعد قليل'. (2) The customer name input allows maxLength 60 (Book.tsx:89) but the server accepts 2–40 (service.ts:86), so 41–60 characters fail with invalid_name. (3) 'too_many_people' has no Arabic text in api.ts. (4) The CtaBand default text (site.tsx:209) always promises pay-on-arrival, and site.tsx:92 assumes payOnArrival=true before settings load, while the setting defaults to false. (5) The WhatsApp links use hard-coded CENTRE.whatsapp in CtaBand, Visit and Contact, not settings.phone. (6) The booking_confirmed push text hard-codes 'فوكس بوينت' instead of settings.centre_name. (7) Staff can block customers through the API (route access 'team', team.ts:162) although the nav shows Customers to admins only. (8) The server has no booking horizon: only the web limits customers to 14 days. (9) The address fallback in CENTRE ('درعا – شارع المجمع الحكومي – بناء العايش') is punctuated differently from the settings default ('درعا، شارع المجمع الحكومي – بناء العايش').

Completeness check. I grepped web/src, api/src, web/index.html, web/public/privacy.html and android/ for Arabic text, URLs, images, colours and numeric constants, then compared the results with the four inventories. Read only, nothing was edited.

On the customer side the four lists are essentially complete. Every Arabic string in the booking pages, the site pages, format.ts, api.ts, notify.ts, tz.ts and settings.ts maps to an existing key. What they missed is mostly:

(a) The team panel (web/src/team/**), which none of them read beyond the Settings tabs:
- a WhatsApp message the customer actually receives, with the brand name written in
- a second copy of the room-type, amenity, capacity and payment-method labels, worded differently from the customer copy
- a second copy of the error messages, which repeat the limits
- a hand-made copy of the payment screen in the admin preview
- the staff/admin permissions, the walk-in booking rules and the booking-edit rules

(b) Two booking-model rules:
- One booking holds the whole room. The 8-seat open space can't be booked per seat.
- A room that has ever been booked is switched off instead of deleted.

(c) Loose ends:
- the Twitter/OG-alt meta tags
- the booking and team pages have no page title of their own
- the English half and the "last updated" date of the privacy page
- the Android shortcut and splash/icon colours
- fonts
- the fixed 4-door drawing for private rooms
- the fixed route list (no custom pages)
- there is no link to the Play Store app
- the people-field default

New mismatches found:
1. On a new device the team panel loads only 60 days of bookings (sync.ts:73), but the store keeps 90 and the on-screen note promises 90.
2. Pay-on-arrival bookings sit in awaiting_verification. So a cash booking the team never confirms is expired 30 minutes after it ends, and the customer gets «لم يصلنا رقم عملية الدفع». These bookings also get no reminder.
3. Walk-in bookings have no device, so the customer gets no push or inbox messages.
4. When the team edits a booking (new room or time, or a new price), the customer is not told.
5. The client keeps its own copies of the 8-hour day price and the 30-minute verification grace (team/util.ts, lib/booking.ts, the Rooms hint). If the server rule becomes editable, these copies have to follow it.

Only the items that are missing from the four lists are returned.
